sentences.text: Alle folk jobber. Anna er sykepleier, og Marta baker brød.
sentences.english: All people work. Anna is a nurse, and Marta bakes bread.

sentences.text: Folk i Bergen jobber hver dag.
sentences.english: People in Bergen work every day.

sentences.text: Anna er sykepleier. Hun jobber på klinikken.
sentences.english: Anna is a nurse. She works at the clinic.

sentences.text: Lars er lærer. Han jobber på skolen.
sentences.english: Lars is a teacher. He works at the school.

sentences.text: Marta er bestemor, men hun jobber også.
sentences.english: Marta is a grandmother, but she works too.

sentences.text: Hun baker brød, og hun selger brød på markedet.
sentences.english: She bakes bread, and she sells bread at the market.

sentences.text: Alle jobber hver dag. Sam jobber ikke nå. Han vil lære norsk.
sentences.english: Everyone works every day. Sam is not working now. He wants to learn Norwegian.

sentences.text: Nils er ti år. Han jobber ikke. Han går på skolen.
sentences.english: Nils is ten years old. He does not work. He goes to school.

sentences.text: Klokka åtte jobber Anna på klinikken.
sentences.english: At eight o'clock Anna works at the clinic.

sentences.text: Mange pasienter er på klinikken.
sentences.english: Many patients are at the clinic.

sentences.text: Anna hjelper pasientene.
sentences.english: Anna helps the patients.

sentences.text: Hvordan går det med deg?
sentences.english: How are you?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg er veldig trøtt.
sentences.english: I am very tired.
sentences.speaker: pasient

sentences.text: Jeg vil hjelpe deg.
sentences.english: I want to help you.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Takk, sykepleier!
sentences.english: Thank you, nurse!
sentences.speaker: pasient

sentences.text: Anna jobber mye, og hun er ofte trøtt. Men hun er glad.
sentences.english: Anna works a lot, and she is often tired. But she is happy.

sentences.text: Anna er en bra sykepleier. Pasienten er glad nå.
sentences.english: Anna is a good nurse. The patient is happy now.

sentences.text: Hun vil hjelpe folk hver dag.
sentences.english: She wants to help people every day.

sentences.text: Alle liker Anna.
sentences.english: Everyone likes Anna.

sentences.text: Lars jobber mye. Han er ofte trøtt også. Han drikker kaffe.
sentences.english: Lars works a lot. He is often tired too. He drinks coffee.

sentences.text: Marta baker brød hver dag.
sentences.english: Marta bakes bread every day.

sentences.text: Hva jobber du med, Marta?
sentences.english: What is your work, Marta?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg baker brød og selger brød. Folk liker brødet mitt!
sentences.english: I bake bread and sell bread. People like my bread!
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg vil også jobbe en dag.
sentences.english: I want to work one day too.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Bra! Du vil lære norsk. Du vil lære mye.
sentences.english: Good! You want to learn Norwegian. You want to learn a lot.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg er ofte hos deg, Marta. Alle i byen liker deg.
sentences.english: I am often at your place, Marta. Everyone in town likes you.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Takk, Sam! Mange folk er glad i brød.
sentences.english: Thank you, Sam! Many people are fond of bread.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Anna, Lars og Marta jobber mye.
sentences.english: Anna, Lars and Marta work a lot.

sentences.text: Hvem er læreren i familien til Anna? Det er Lars.
sentences.english: Who is the teacher in Anna's family? It is Lars.

sentences.text: Marta jobber, men hun lager også middag. I dag er det fisk, poteter og suppe.
sentences.english: Marta works, but she also makes dinner. Today there is fish, potatoes and soup.

sentences.text: Lars har mange elever. Skolen begynner klokka åtte, og klokka to er skolen slutt.
sentences.english: Lars has many pupils. School begins at eight o'clock, and at two o'clock school is over.

sentences.text: Elevene har lekse, og elevene skriver mye.
sentences.english: The pupils have homework, and the pupils write a lot.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Anna betaler middagen i dag.
sentences.english: Anna pays for the dinner today.
